items.name: motion
items.title: Motion
items.description: Small animated pieces: Tabs, Badge, AnimatedNumber, TextSwap, useReveal, SuccessCheck, Switch, SearchField, Checkbox, IconSwap, DotLoader and Odometer. Styles and motion included.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Bottom sheet on phones that drags down to close, centred dialog on bigger screens. Escape closes the top one; the page stays locked until all are gone.

items.name: toasts
items.title: Toasts
items.description: Stacked toasts. A new one rises in front, older ones step back, a fourth pushes the oldest out. useToasts() gives you toast(text, tone).

items.name: plus-menu
items.title: Plus menu
items.description: A + that grows into the menu it opens. Pass it items with a label, hint, icon and onSelect.

items.name: effects
items.title: Effects
items.description: For special moments only, like a guest's key card or a welcome: HoloSurface, Holo, Guilloche, EncryptedText, GlowText, BorderLight and GlowCursor, from the Morris OS key card. No more than 1 or 2 on a screen.
